divergences.reason: axiolid-mesh-compile 0.3.31 (axiolid/kernel#343, #452) reports a faceted B-rep face without a surface Certified with its slab width unless its corners are exactly coplanar. One body of this model has a face whose corners span 3.4e-7 m about its plane, within the tolerance, which 0.3.30 counted as planar; it is now declared within that width, a tessellation, and the services that measure only exact bodies there leave the value open.
divergences.decision: Accepted: the body was called exact while its face is warped, so the recorded value rested on a claim the kernel no longer makes. The rule fails closed instead; widths no larger than the 1e-9 m the services read as one point stay rounding.
